title: A rustle before thunder
description: Read each staggered lightning lane from a roofed pocket, hop the bramble cuts between strikes, and cross only while the lane is dark. Expert redesign: crossed storm beams and shelter doors.

rooms.name: The first thunder lane
rooms.lesson: Amber warns · white lightning hurts · cross when dark. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: Below the storm wall
rooms.lesson: The roof keeps you low between the storm lanes. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The staggered strikes
rooms.lesson: Each lane has its own warning rhythm. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The lightning lookout
rooms.lesson: Climb around the tower before the next exposed crossing. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The long storm arcade
rooms.lesson: Take one refuge at a time. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The storm wind
rooms.lesson: Brake against the gust between the storm walls. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: Out of the thunder
rooms.lesson: Cross the high storm walk to the final shelter. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
